title: RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT t

translated_title: RAPID：可靠性感知的样本对重要性蒸馏
translated_abstract: 样本间关系蒸馏通过匹配小批量内样本之间的关系来迁移教师模型的表示几何结构。计算所有样本对具有相对于批大小的二次复杂度，而均匀子采样可能无法有效利用有限的关系预算。我们提出了可靠性感知的样本对重要性蒸馏，即 RAPID，它将可靠性门控的关系目标与全支撑集的自适应样本对提议分离开来。可靠性决定了哪些教师关系被强调，而校准后的教师熵和分离的学生-教师残差决定了哪些关系被评估。精确的逆提议校正使损失和梯度估计器相对于门控的小批量目标是条件无偏的。我们在两个文本分类设置中评估了 RAPID：在 AG News 数据集上使用三个配对随机种子和 256 的关系预算进行 BERT 到 DistilBERT 的蒸馏，以及在 SST-2 数据集上使用 DistilBERT 进行蒸馏（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: RAPID 通过将可靠性门控的关系目标与自适应样本对提议相结合，并利用精确的逆提议校正实现条件无偏估计，从而解决了关系蒸馏中全对计算的二次复杂度问题，高效利用有限的关系预算。
en_tdlr: RAPID combines a reliability-gated relational target with adaptive pair proposals and exact inverse proposal correction to achieve conditionally unbiased loss and gradient estimation, efficiently addressing the quadratic complexity of computing all pairs in relational distillation under a limited relation budget.
